headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP net revenue across Data Center and Communications & Other end markets.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated Net Revenue ($M): Marvell posted $2,739.30M in Q2 FY27 (+36.5% YoY). Management guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $3,150M (±5%, +51.8% YoY); Yahoo consensus sits at $3,152.21M (+51.95% YoY) while buy-side whispers look for $3,210M–$3,260M+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share excluding $326.2M SBC and acquisition intangible amortization.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Consensus is $1.10/sh (matching Q3 guide $1.10 ±$0.05 vs $0.94 in Q2 FY27 and $0.76 in Q3 FY26). Marvell has beaten consensus EPS 4 consecutive quarters (+1.42% avg surprise).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Hyperscaler custom AI ASICs/XPUs, electro-optics DSPs, Teralynx switches, and Celestial AI interconnects.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Data Center Revenue ($M): Surged +45.7% YoY to $2,171.50M in Q2 FY27 (79.3% of total revenue). Custom AI XPU ramps and 800G/1.6T optical interconnects are expected to push Q3 Data Center above $2.56B (>81% mix).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP gross margin balancing high-margin optical DSPs against lower-margin custom AI ASIC ramps.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Gross Margin (%): Printed 58.9% in Q2 FY27 (53.1% GAAP). Management guided Q3 Non-GAAP GM slightly lower to 57.5%–58.5% due to rapid H2 mix shift toward custom AI silicon.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Multi-Year AI Revenue & Lumentum Deal Framing ($B)
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Progress toward ~$12B FY27 / ~$18B FY28 revenue targets and Lumentum Holdings all-stock deal dilution clarity.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: FY27/FY28 AI Trajectory & M&A: Management previously raised FY27 revenue outlook to ~$12B and FY28 to ~$18B on hyperscaler ASIC bookings, while the announced all-stock Lumentum acquisition faces investor scrutiny over ~1/3 share dilution.
